name: Sanjay
title: Flutter Engineer | Cross-Platform Solutions
bio:
Hello! I'm Sanjay, a passionate Flutter Developer with 2.5 years of experience in building high-quality iOS, Android, and Web applications. I specialize in developing intuitive user interfaces, creating seamless user experiences, and transforming ideas into scalable and reliable digital solutions.

My journey in software development started with a curiosity about how applications work, which grew into a strong passion for building innovative products. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges, exploring modern technologies, and continuously enhancing my skills to deliver efficient and user-focused applications.

I have experience developing cross-platform applications using Flutter, with a strong focus on clean architecture, performance optimization, and writing maintainable code. I enjoy collaborating with teams to deliver impactful solutions across mobile and web platforms.

education.institution: Kamarajar Government Arts College, Surandai, Tenkasi

experience.description: Currently developing and maintaining Android mobile applications using Flutter. Key responsibilities include REST API integration, implementing in-app webview, HSL video player, and YouTube player. Also proficient in integrating Razorpay, Google Maps, push notifications, and deep linking. Utilized Riverpod and GetX for efficient state management.

Developed cross-platform mobile and web applications using Flutter. Gained hands-on experience in API integration, implementing third-party payment gateways like Razorpay, basic routing, and integrating Google Maps. Utilized state management solutions including Riverpod, Cubit, and GetX.

projects.title: Snapper
projects.description: Snapper is an Android application designed to streamline e-commerce with integrated global payment handling through WebView. The app supports real-time updates via REST APIs, and features efficient state management using Riverpod. It also integrates Deeplinking for seamless deep navigation across the app, ensuring a smooth user experience.

projects.title: StarsNSigns
projects.description: A comprehensive course providing mobile application developed using Flutter. Features include robust REST API integration, seamless HLS video player functionality, and efficient state management with Riverpod and GetX.

projects.title: King Jobs
projects.description: A productivity application focused on simplifying the job search. Users can efficiently manage tasks, projects, and deadlines, while also leveraging a skill-based job searching feature to find highly relevant opportunities.

projects.title: Matrimony App
projects.description: A robust matrimony application designed to connect users, featuring a fully functional web view experience with seamless error handling and native Android support for an enhanced user interface and performance.

projects.title: Pearl King
projects.description: Pearl King is a single-vendor e-commerce application designed for seamless online sales. The app offers a user-friendly interface for browsing, purchasing products, and managing sales orders. It supports real-time updates using REST APIs and incorporates efficient state management with Riverpod for a smooth user experience.

projects.title: Narain Promotors
projects.description: Narain Promotors is an application designed to streamline customer service and issue management for service-based businesses. The app provides an efficient platform for managing customer requests, tracking service appointments, and handling maintenance issues like pipe repairs, wall issues, and broken appliances. It supports real-time updates using REST APIs for issue tracking and integrates Riverpod for state management, ensuring a smooth and responsive user experience for both customers and staff.
